optimization-continuation-result.stop_reason: Reached the owner-required 100 consecutive attempts without a statistically supported retained speed improvement. The 50 ms average is aspirational and was not used as a stopping condition.
optimization-continuation-result.statistical_method: 48 games per arm in 12 matched starting-order pairs. Balanced randomized AB/BA order. Exact one-sided paired sign-flip permutation test over run means, p <= 0.005 and lower candidate mean. A second independent 12-pair/48-game-per-arm fixture bank must pass the same gate before retaining. All samples/outliers included; run is the cluster. Engine RNG remains production behavior.
optimization-continuation-result.limitations: Timing variance remains substantial despite identical observed paired workloads. Failure to pass the gate is not proof of no possible benefit, especially for small effects. This is a finite set of implementation and parameter-tuning experiments, not a proof of global optimality. Fixture results are complemented by a separate normal-production-shuffle sample. Phase timers overlap and must not be summed. The full soak was never restarted.
